findings_for_reviewer_planner: FINDING 1 (functional, §15c/§15e MISS — SAFE direction): the real LLM classifies a bare clean surname that also reads as a customer name ('tan', 'Wong') as a NEW customer-order business_query (domain_hint:order + a current_message customer entity), so _isNewQuery=true and the name-resolution arm never fires. The member_offer is abandoned and re-run as a customer-order lookup. NO wrong member resolve occurs (escalation.preferred_assignee_id never set). This is plan §5's residual tension manifesting on the SAFE (false-abandon) side, not the dangerous (false-resolve) side. Effect: the feature reliably resolves names WITH an honorific (15a/15b) and non-customer-shaped typos (15d), but bare ambiguous surnames fall through to a query. Planner/reviewer decision: accept (helpful re-run, never wrong-assign) or strengthen the prompt to bias bare names toward person_mention-only when an open member_offer exists. Note the same mechanism is exactly what makes 15k SAFE — tightening it risks the wrong-resolve edge.

FINDING 2 (matcher correctness): the Δ-code matcher is correct. 15d confirms the substring tier; 15b confirms honorific stripping + case-fold; 15f confirms the tiered exact->token collection + the ambiguity gate (>1 -> 'multi', never single-pick). 15c/15e misses are NOT matcher bugs — the arm is gated out upstream by _isNewQuery.

FINDING 3 (HARD safety, PASS): 15k (person-naming new query in member_offer) abandons via _isNewQuery and does NOT resolve to u-tan; 15f (two-Tan ambiguity) reprompts 'multi' and never single-picks. Both highest-risk wrong-assign paths are protected.

FINDING 4 (wiring note): the clone invokes human-intervention sub vUfFUDjLAuMaeQE6 (a guarded clone-local copy), NOT the rrYXzE61gCNUck_zmXe-G listed in CLAUDE.md. It is verified guarded (test-guard short-circuit). Reviewer should confirm vUfFUDjLAuMaeQE6's guard mirrors the published live human-intervention sub before promotion, and that the live spine, when promoted, will hit the correctly-guarded production path (the clone's guard does not exist in live; promotion strips guards).

FINDING 5 (no new token sink): only the reformulator gpt-5.4-mini runs per turn (always-extract person_mention is additive within the same call); no reformulator-side reformulator-of-reformulator and Basic LLM Chain stayed dark.
